name: aalto-light
description: Afferent design concept 'Aalto Light': Finnish functionalist heritage (free-form wave, bent birch, the Paimio idea of designing for a person lying in bed), kaamos blue turning to spring light. Material 3 roles on top. No red anywhere.

deep_fjord.role: Night base: surface in the dark scheme, sky top in kaamos

kaamos_blue.role: Brand colour and seed: app icon field, high containers, the world before colour returns

frost.role: Cold light, ice, secondary text on night

lilac_haze.role: Blue hour, the in-between state, measure tasks

birch_white.role: Text on night, snow, light-scheme surface. The brightest value at night

birch_ply.role: Warm neutral: laminate bands, streak, frames, secondary accent

ply_edge.role: Lamination lines, dividers on warm surfaces

paimio_yellow.role: The one sun: primary action, the lantern, the streak's newest layer. One per screen

dawn_apricot.role: Dawn horizon, gentle attention (replaces the error role; never red)

ceiling_green.role: Paimio ceiling: calm wash for breath and loyly, light-scheme tertiary container

m3.notes: Dark (kaamos) is the default for the morning game in bed and the start and end screens. Light (kevat) is the patient view by day and the clinician dashboard. The error role is apricot, used only for connection problems; clinical states use their own tokens with labels.

clinic_states.rule: Always with a text label, never colour alone, never red

plain.use: Title, body, label: all UI and the dashboard (tabular figures)

voice.use: The quote after a session only

signature.wave_edge: Top edge of bottom sheets and the end card: one asymmetric free-form curve, low on the left, rising to the right (the shoreline), amplitude 18 px on a phone
signature.laminate_band: Bent ribbon of 4 to 6 parallel lines, used for the streak, dividers and the task frame edge
signature.window: Task panel: tall rounded rectangle (radius 32) with a 6 px birch-ply frame showing two lamination lines
signature.sun: Perfect circle, the only geometric primitive; used for the primary button state dot, progress and the week row
signature.pebble: Rounded free-form blob for chips and the streak badge, never a perfect pill on decorative elements

shape.rules: No sharp corners, no zigzags, no straight horizon in the art. UI controls stay M3-clean (pills, rounded rects); the free curve appears once per screen.

spring_bend.use: Task window opening along a curved path, laminate layer pressing in

breath.use: Lantern, aurora, fog, figure; 6 breaths per minute, never faster

daylight_sweep.use: Colour return: low light travels from the sun side across the world

dawn.use: Sun crests the fell; bedside light ramps on the same curve

motion.reduced_motion: Crossfades instead of paths and springs, parallax x0.5, no particles faster than 0.2 screen per second, no flashes

bedside.session_follow: During the session the lamp follows the world stage: kaamos off, first light #FFB54A 8, blue hour #FFD27A 15, kevat dawn #FFF0D2 60 over 8 s
bedside.rule: Warm only, never blue light before the player is up, never flashes
